editorial:
Picture this: your screw-up brother gets snatched, and everyone assumes he planned it himself. That's the mess you're dropped into with this crime thriller. Adrian Grenier plays the successful sibling who has to drop everything and go rogue to save his brother, played by Johnathon Schaech. Nicolas Cage shows up as a wild, over-the-top crime boss who chews every scene he's in, while John Cusack plays a shady cop who may or may not be on your side. The vibe is gritty and pulpy, like a straight-to-video action flick from the nineties, with lots of yelling, gunplay, and bad decisions.

The acting is a mixed bag. Cage is entertaining in that unhinged way only he can deliver, but the story feels rushed and the action can be confusing. Still, if you enjoy B-movie crime thrillers and don't mind rough edges, there's some fun here. Fans of Cage's wilder performances will get a kick out of it. Everyone else might want to skip. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you're a collector.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you follow the businessman as he finally tracks down the kidnapper's hideout. A bloody shootout breaks out, and the brother is freed just in time. The crime boss is killed, and the shady cop's true loyalties are revealed. The brothers walk away battered but alive, having learned that family loyalty matters more than money or pride.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves over-the-top Nicolas Cage performances and B-movie crime thrillers.
